Distribution of the responses for the notion that dimmed streetlights pose a security risk at night. 4.2.4.2 Summary of Findings Most respondents agreed that streetlights should be dimmed if safety and security are not affected, regardless of whether their city currently dims or not. Those living in cities that dimmed their streetlights were less likely to be deterred from venturing out at night and were also less likely to be affected in their choice of transportation.
